documents.title: Blue Lantern Hotel, Europa
documents.text: Europa's Blue Lantern Hotel sits beneath the moon's ice. Guests travel by submarine and watch glowing sea creatures through glass walls.

documents.title: Mars Canyon Railway
documents.text: The Mars Canyon Railway crosses a red desert between towering cliffs. Sunrise tickets include breakfast in the observation car.

documents.title: Venus Cloud Garden
documents.text: The Venus Cloud Garden floats above the storms. Visitors walk among luminous orchids and watch the sunset from a balloon deck.

documents.title: Titan Lakeside Club
documents.text: Titan's Lakeside Club leads kayak trips across quiet methane lakes beneath Saturn. Warm suits and beginner lessons are included.

documents.title: Moon Museum
documents.text: The Moon Museum preserves footprints, tools, and photographs from early lunar expeditions inside a silver-domed gallery.

documents.title: Comet Kitchen
documents.text: The Comet Kitchen serves frozen desserts that change color in zero gravity. Its tasting menu is designed for adventurous families.

documents.title: Mercury Night Market
documents.text: The Mercury Night Market opens during the long cold night and sells mirrored hats, solar tea, and handmade rover parts.

documents.title: Saturn Ring Observatory
documents.text: Saturn's Ring Observatory offers telescope tours focused on icy rings, shepherd moons, and planetary weather.
